card.name: Middle of "myeloma" and similar words
card.fires_on: The piece "el" inside "myeloma" after "Multiple My" in cancer drug labels. It also fires weakly on a few other word pieces, such as "iel" in riel and "al" in lenalidomide.

modes.label: Multiple myeloma
modes.description: The "el" piece in the middle of "myeloma" after "Multiple My" in dosing headings and indications.
modes.example: Multiple My<<el>>oma in Combination with Dexamethas

modes.label: Other word pieces
modes.description: Rare other partial words, such as the currency riel or lenalidomide.

card.plain: It fires on the middle of the word myeloma, as in multiple myeloma, in cancer drug labels.
